title: OSR Meta File
description: Root meta.json file describing an OSR rule set: version, load manifest, feature flags, extensions. Conforms to EARS Specification OSR v0.1, §5.2–5.3.

osr_version.description: SemVer version of the OSR format used. Per OSR-N-001.

domain.description: The mathematical domain of this rule set (e.g., algebra, integration).

title.description: Human-readable title of this rule set.

source_version.description: Version of the original source rules this file set was converted from (if applicable).

description.description: Human-readable description of this rule set.

rule_count.description: Total number of rules across all files.

test_count.description: Total number of test problems across all test files.
